enumDescriptions: Use omp (Oh My Pi) when found, otherwise pi
Oh My Pi: standalone binary, state in ~/.omp/agent
oh-my-pi-chater.backend.description: Default agent CLI family to run in RPC mode. Switching backend in the chat or settings panel applies only to the current workspace window and overrides this default there. Reload the window after changing.

oh-my-pi-chater.cliPath.description: Path to the omp or pi executable (default: auto-detect from PATH). With backend "auto", a file named omp* selects omp.

oh-my-pi-chater.nodePath.description: pi backend only: Node.js binary used to run pi (default: node next to pi on PATH). Set this if native tools (memory_search) fail with NODE_MODULE_VERSION errors.

oh-my-pi-chater.thinkingLevel.description: Default thinking level for Pi agent responses

oh-my-pi-chater.autoApproveTools.description: Automatically approve tool executions without confirmation

oh-my-pi-chater.showAllModels.description: List every model the agent reports, including providers configured only via env vars or models.json/models.yml. Off: only providers you signed in to with /login (pi auth.json / omp credential store).

oh-my-pi-chater.favoriteModels.description: Starred models (`provider/id`) offered by the model chip under the chat input. Star or unstar models with the ☆ button in the full model picker (switch button of the model status line at the top of the chat, or /model).

oh-my-pi-chater.contextUsageWarningThres.description: Show a warning when context usage exceeds this percentage of the context window

oh-my-pi-chater.promptRecommendedPackage.description: When Pi CLI sync is on, prompt to install recommended Pi packages (~/.pi/agent) if they are missing.

oh-my-pi-chater.autoInstallRecommendedPa.description: Install recommended Pi packages automatically on startup without asking (requires network/npm).

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttUrl.markdownDescription: Voice input: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text endpoint, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8010/v1` (speaches / faster-whisper-server) or `https://api.openai.com/v1`. A bare host gets `/v1`; `/audio/transcriptions` is appended. Empty disables recording.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.sttModel.description: Voice input: transcription model id. Empty uses the first model the server lists at /models.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.language.description: Voice input: ISO-639-1 language hint (zh, en, …). Empty lets the model detect it per utterance.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadConfidence.description: Voice input: Silero VAD speech probability threshold. Lower it (e.g. 0.35) if quiet speech is missed; raise it if background noise gets transcribed.

oh-my-pi-chater.voice.vadStopSecs.description: Voice input: pause (seconds) that ends an utterance and sends it to speech-to-text.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.model.description: Voice agent: model (provider/id) for the voice conversation, on the active backend (omp or pi). Empty uses the current chat tab's model when the voice agent starts. Takes effect after Voice Agent — Stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.thinking.description: Voice agent: thinking level. Off keeps spoken replies fast. Takes effect after Voice Agent — Stop.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.confirmBefore.description: Voice agent: a new task for an idle worker is only sent after you agree to the plan in a later message.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.followPi.description: Voice agent: follow Pi when VS Code starts. Following, the editor opens and scrolls to the code Pi talks about, reads or writes; typing in the editor stops following. Toggle with the eye button in the editor title bar or Pi's status bar item.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.discoverPrevi.description: Voice agent: let list_viewers and open_with also use preview commands from installed extensions, not only VS Code's built-in ones such as the Markdown preview. Off by default: many extensions' preview commands need their own arguments or state and may do nothing or never finish. Custom editors from installed extensions (e.g. draw.io) are always offered.

enumDescriptions: Speak up when the worker needs an answer, fails or finishes, and when research comes back.
As important, plus progress updates while the worker is busy.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.narration.description: Voice agent: when it speaks up on its own about the current task.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.minProactiveG.description: Voice agent: quiet seconds after any reply before it announces finished work, research or progress. Worker questions and errors are announced right away.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.narrationInte.description: Voice agent: with narration "all", seconds without a reply before a progress update.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.turnStopSecs.description: Voice mode: seconds of silence that end your turn. Takes effect when voice mode starts.

enumDescriptions: chatterbox-tts (multilingual): sends language zh for sentences with Chinese, en otherwise; reads mixed Chinese and English.
Kokoro-FastAPI: speaks Chinese runs with lang_code z and the rest in the voice's own language.
Any other OpenAI-compatible service: no language field.
oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.provider.description: Voice mode: which kind of text-to-speech service tts.url is; decides how the language is sent.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.url.description: Voice mode: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8881/v1. Takes effect when voice mode starts.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.model.description: Voice mode: text-to-speech model. Empty uses the provider's: chatterbox-multilingual, kokoro, or tts-1.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.tts.voice.description: Voice mode: text-to-speech voice. Empty uses the provider's: default (chatterbox), af_sarah (Kokoro), or alloy.

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.historySessio.description: Voice view: past voice conversations kept per workspace (one per task and voice mode run).

oh-my-pi-chater.voiceAgent.debugTranscri.description: Voice view: also show what each turn sent to the voice model and the updates it chose not to speak about (<silent/>). For troubleshooting.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
